_comment: English strings for the gameplay keys. A list is a pool: the game picks one by seed, never the same line twice in a row. {name} is filled in. All texts are placeholders (TODO(initiator)). #131 turns this into checked localisation tables.
commodity.fizzy_mud.name: fizzy mud
location.drip_rock.name: Drip Rock
location.bent_spoon.name: Bent Spoon
track.wallet.name: credits
track.freight_xp.name: freight XP
unlock.bent_spoon_permit.name: Bent Spoon landing permit
job.first_haul.title: First haul
job.first_haul.brief: Three crates of fizzy mud for Bent Spoon. They fizz less if you don't drop them.
track.standing_courier_office.name: standing with Dinglepost Couriers
track.standing_small_family.name: standing with the Gribbles
job.family_errand.title: A small favour
job.family_errand.brief: Two crates of fizzy mud, no questions.
giver.courier_office.name: Dinglepost Couriers
giver.courier_office.greet.first: New face! We always need a new face. The old ones keep quitting.
Welcome to Dinglepost. The coffee is mud. So is the cargo.
You look employable. That is rare around here.
giver.courier_office.greet.regular: Back again! Management is almost proud.
The reliable one. Our insurance company hates you.
Good to see you. The crates missed you.
giver.courier_office.greet.failure: About last time. We will not talk about last time.
The crates are still crying. Let us do better.
One more chance. Management is counting. Slowly, but counting.
giver.courier_office.intro: Listen closely, I will say this once and then again.
giver.courier_office.reason: The customer is waiting. The customer is always waiting.
It is urgent. Everything is urgent. This one more so.
Do not ask what is inside. It is mostly mud.
giver.courier_office.signoff: Off you go. Walk briskly, not heroically.
giver.small_family.name: The Gribbles
giver.small_family.greet.first: Sit. You have a face we might remember.
Come in, come in. Mind the dog. It is not a dog.
So you are the new one. Aunt Mabel has opinions.
giver.small_family.greet.regular: Again you. Good. The soup is still warm.
giver.small_family.greet.failure: Disappointing. Uncle Bort cried a little.
We spoke about you at dinner. Not kindly.
Careful, now. We have long memories and short tempers.
giver.small_family.intro: It is only a tiny task. Tiny.
giver.small_family.reason: It is a gift. For someone who will not be thanking us.
Do not ask. Aunt Mabel says asking is rude.
giver.small_family.signoff: Go. The soup is getting cold.
briefing.title: {title} for {giver}
{giver} needs: {title}
{title} ({giver})
briefing.shape.few: {amount} crates of {commodity}, {from} to {to}. Not far, not hard.
briefing.shape.many: A big one: {amount} crates of {commodity}, {from} to {to}.
{amount} crates of {commodity} from {from} to {to}. Bring a strong back.
briefing.shape.timed: {amount} crates of {commodity}, {from} to {to}, and the clock is running.
{from} to {to} with {amount} crates of {commodity}. Hurry. The mud is not getting younger.
Quick: {amount} crates of {commodity} from {from} to {to} before the timer wins.
briefing.reason.commodity.fizzy_mud: The mud must stay fizzy, so go easy on the corners.
Fizzy mud goes flat when you rush it. Do not rush it.
briefing.reason.route.dusty: The dust out there makes everyone grumpy, so be early.
Bent Spoon is dusty and impatient.
Dust makes people thirsty and cranky. Deliver before they notice.
briefing.reason.route.wet: Drip Rock is damp and the staff are unhappy about it.
It rains indoors over there. Hurry.
notice.job.accepted: You said yes to {title}. No refunds.
{title} is yours now. Try not to lose it.
notice.job.expired: Too slow: {title} ran out of time.
{title} expired. The mud waits for nobody.
notice.job.failed: Nothing arrived for {title}. The customer sighs.
notice.job.abandoned: {title} abandoned. The crates are now decoration.
notice.job.crate_lost: One crate fewer. It was not insured.
Crate lost. It had a good life.
notice.refused.too_many: Two jobs at a time is plenty.
Your hands are full of jobs.
notice.refused.not_available: Not yet. Come back when you are someone.
They do not know you well enough.
